name: Paratomistoma
sum: Middle Eocene "tomistomine" gavialoid from Wadi Hitan, Egypt, known from the back of a skull.
holotype: CGM 42188 — partial posterior skull and lower jaw, Gehannam Formation, Wadi Hitan, Egypt.
material: Only the holotype, morphologically mature though its skull sutures are unfused.
biology: The sources say nothing about its biology.
author: Brochu and Gingerich 2000

sources.text: Brochu, Christopher A. 2000. New tomistomine crocodylian from the Middle Eocene (Bartonian) of Wadi Hitan, Fayum Province, Egypt. Contributions from the Museum of Paleontology 30(10): 251–268.
